test.create_query: CREATE TABLE statistics_small_read (p UInt16, k UInt32, d Date, x UInt64, y UInt8, z UInt8) ENGINE = MergeTree PARTITION BY p ORDER BY (k, d) SETTINGS index_granularity = 1024, index_granularity_bytes = 0, min_bytes_for_wide_part = 0
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO statistics_small_read SELECT intDiv(number, 200000), intHash32(number) % 100000, toDate('2026-01-01') + intHash64(number) % 30, number, number % 3 = 0, number % 7 = 0 FROM numbers_mt(100000000) SETTINGS max_partitions_per_insert_block = 0
SELECT throwIf(count() != 500) FROM system.parts WHERE database = currentDatabase() AND table = 'statistics_small_read' AND active
